capture_id.description: Single-use capture returned by a visual-ref screenshot; requires image coordinates.

glide.description: Glide the pointer to the click point along a humanised trajectory instead of teleporting. Mutually exclusive with `capture_id`.

ref.description: Optional `@e<N>` ref allocated by the last `tool.snapshot`. Mutually exclusive with `selector` (caller must supply exactly one). Accepts both `"e3"` and `"@e3"`.

tab_id.description: Target tab. Defaults to the Agent Window's active tab.

x.description: Viewport-relative X coordinate (CSS pixels). When both `x` and `y` are supplied the click is dispatched at this point without resolving an element; both must be given together and neither may be combined with `ref`/`selector`/`capture_id`.

KeyModifier.description: Keyboard modifier flags. Multiple flags may be combined; the extension folds them into CDP's bitfield (`alt=1, ctrl=2, meta=4, shift=8`).
